chrome.footerBlurb: Private online tools for compressing, resizing, converting and preparing images for the web.

home.title: Compress, resize, crop, convert, geotag, inspect and edit image SEO metadata, and generate AI alt text — start free, no login.
home.subtitle: Consumer image tools with private temporary processing. Free guest limits apply. Sign in later for projects and bulk.
home.limits: Free guest: up to 10 MB per file, 5 operations per 24 hours, files deleted after 1 hour.
home.privacy: Uploads are private. Temporary files expire in one hour. Downloads do not extend expiry.
home.toolGridBody: Single-image tools and Bulk Image Tools share one guest privacy model. Checkout remains optional.
home.uploadHint: Drop an image to open Compress. No account required.

upload.dropAria: Upload image by dropping, browsing, or pasting
upload.privacy: Private temporary storage. Deleted after one hour.

compare.afterPlaceholder: Processed preview appears after you run the tool

limitsBanner.title: Guest free limits
limitsBanner.body: {used} of {limit} operations used in the current 24-hour window. Max file size {maxMb} MB.
limitsBanner.windowBody: {limit} free image operations are available during each 24-hour period.
limitsBanner.usedToday: {used} of {limit} free image operations used today

upgrade.title: Need larger bulk batches or saved history?
upgrade.body: Sign in or create an account for higher public bulk limits and dashboard project tools. Paid checkout is available only when Price IDs are configured.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Upload an image to get started.

compress.subtitle: Shrink JPEG, PNG, and WebP for the web — private, temporary, no login.
compress.dropHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP · up to 10 MB · deleted after 1 hour
compress.optionsHint: Pick a preset. Use the slider for finer control — engine values stay private.
compress.afterPlaceholder: Compressed preview appears after you compress
compress.expiryNotice: Images are automatically deleted after one hour. Downloading does not extend storage time.

resize.subtitle: Resize JPEG, PNG, and WebP by width, height, or fit — private, temporary, no login.
resize.optionsHint: Choose a method or preset. Pixels only. Exact size stays locked until a later release.
resize.exactLocked: Exact Size unlocks in a later prompt
resize.qualityNoteBefore: Need JPG quality or a smaller file after resizing?
resize.qualityNoteAfter: lets you balance clarity and download size. Resize controls dimensions only.
resize.expiryNotice: Images are automatically deleted after one hour. Downloading does not extend storage time.

crop.subtitle: Crop JPEG, PNG, and WebP privately — free or fixed ratios, no login.
crop.editorHint: Select the area you want to keep. Drag to move, resize from the corner, or use the keyboard controls.
crop.waitingImage: Upload an image to start cropping
crop.expiryNotice: Images are automatically deleted after one hour. Downloading does not extend storage time.

convert.subtitle: Convert your image to another format — private, temporary, no login.
convert.optionsHint: Choose an output format. Same-format optimization lives in Compress.
convert.pngLosslessNote: PNG uses lossless compression settings (not a lossy quality slider).
convert.avifNote: AVIF support varies by device and browser. Compatibility is not guaranteed everywhere.
convert.avifUnavailable: AVIF encoding is not available in this runtime.
convert.sameFormatHint: Need a smaller file in the same format?
convert.alphaWarningBody: JPEG does not support transparency. Choose a background color to flatten.
convert.metadataNotice: Private camera metadata is removed during conversion.
convert.expiryNotice: Images are automatically deleted after one hour. Downloading does not extend storage time.

geotag.subtitle: Add GPS coordinates to a JPEG — private, temporary, no login.
geotag.optionsHint: Enter coordinates manually or use your current location after an explicit click.
geotag.jpegOnly: JPEG images are supported for verified embedded GPS writing.
geotag.formatUnsupportedTitle: This image format does not support verified GPS writing
geotag.formatUnsupportedBody: Convert your image to JPEG first, then return to Geotag. We do not convert silently.
geotag.existingUnreadable: Existing GPS could not be safely read
geotag.replaceConfirmHint: Replace existing location. Old GPS tags are removed before new tags are written.
geotag.replaceRequired: Confirm replacement before geotagging when GPS already exists.
geotag.latitudeHint: Between −90 and 90. Up to 6 decimal places.
geotag.longitudeHint: Between −180 and 180. Up to 6 decimal places.
geotag.altitudeHint: Optional. Metres above or below sea level. Not high-accuracy.
geotag.locationLabelHint: Optional display label only — not verified reverse-geocoding.
geotag.geoPermissionHint: Location permission is optional. HTTPS required in most browsers. Coordinates are not stored in the browser.
geotag.geoUnavailable: Location is unavailable on this device.
geotag.privacyNotice: Your coordinates and image are deleted within one hour. Coordinates are never sent to analytics.
geotag.metadataPolicyNotice: Non-GPS EXIF is stripped for privacy. Orientation may be retained.
geotag.expiryNotice: Images are automatically deleted after one hour. Downloading does not extend storage time.

metadata.subtitle: View image details and safe metadata — private, temporary, no login.
metadata.optionsHint: Inspect trusted server-extracted information. The original image is never rewritten.
metadata.viewerOnly: Viewer only — no image download or rewrite.
metadata.cameraUnavailable: No camera EXIF fields available for this image.
metadata.privacyNotice: Your image and metadata are deleted within one hour. Sensitive fields are allow-listed only.
metadata.expiryNotice: Images and metadata are automatically deleted after one hour.

fields.printSizeNote: Print size is calculated from embedded density when present — not a physical property of the file. Missing density is not invented.

gps.unreadable: GPS metadata could not be safely read
gps.sensitive: Location data is sensitive. Coordinates are not sent to analytics and are deleted with your session.

aiAlt.subtitle: Generate accessible and SEO-friendly image metadata — private, temporary, no login.
aiAlt.optionsHint: Choose a purpose and output language. Generation runs server-side only.
aiAlt.privacyNotice: Your image is sent securely to the configured AI provider to generate the requested metadata. The image and generated result are removed from this application within one hour.
aiAlt.reviewWarning: AI-generated content may contain mistakes. Review it before using it on your website.
aiAlt.expiryNotice: Your image and AI result are deleted within one hour. Download and copy do not extend expiry.

metadataEditor.subtitle: Add and organize image metadata for websites — private, temporary, no login.
metadataEditor.optionsHint: Start blank or import AI-generated metadata from the same upload in this guest session.
metadataEditor.formats: Supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP (static images). This tool does not modify image pixels.
metadataEditor.aiImportHint: Import only works when a completed AI Alt Text result exists for this same image in this session. No new AI request is made.
metadataEditor.altCmsNote: Alt text must normally be added in your website or CMS. It is not a universal image-binary metadata field.
metadataEditor.importAiHint: Imports the latest completed AI Alt Text result for this image. Content still needs review.
metadataEditor.noAiResult: No AI result found for this image.
metadataEditor.aiReviewWarning: Review AI content before using it. Import does not call the AI provider again.
metadataEditor.decorative: Decorative image — use empty alt text
metadataEditor.decorativeHint: Decorative images should not convey essential content. HTML preview uses alt="".
metadataEditor.title: Image title
metadataEditor.caption: Caption
metadataEditor.filenameBoundary: Suggested filename applies only to the download name. It does not rename the private stored original.
metadataEditor.keywordsHint: Keywords are normalized and deduplicated. They do not guarantee search rankings.
metadataEditor.noIssues: No issues recorded yet. Run Validate metadata.
metadataEditor.rankingDisclaimer: These checks are recommendations and do not guarantee search rankings.
metadataEditor.htmlPreviewHint: Escaped code examples with placeholder paths only — not signed storage URLs, and not executed on this page.
metadataEditor.cmsHint: Neutral CMS field mapping. CMS support varies. Export does not publish automatically. Alt text is normally stored in the CMS or page record; embedded image metadata is separate.
metadataEditor.exportNoPublish: Exporting metadata does not publish it to a website.
metadataEditor.aiNotFound: No importable AI result for this image.
metadataEditor.filenameRequired: Enter a valid suggested filename first.
metadataEditor.expiryNotice: Your image and metadata are deleted within one hour. Save, export, and download do not extend expiry.

errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Check your request and try again. Crop area may be outside the image.
errors.GUEST_LIMIT_REACHED: Guest operation limit reached. Try again later or create an account.
errors.GUEST_ACTIVE_JOB_EXISTS: Wait for the current job to finish.
errors.STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED: Storage is not available right now.
errors.OBJECT_TOO_LARGE: File is too large for guest limits.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Use JPEG, PNG, or WebP. SVG, TIFF, HEIC, PDF, and ZIP are not supported.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Image validation failed. Crop area may be too small.
errors.CORRUPT_IMAGE: The image could not be decoded.
errors.OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: This operation is not available yet.
errors.GUEST_AI_TIMEOUT: The AI provider timed out. Try again later.
errors.GUEST_AI_RATE_LIMITED: AI rate limit reached. Try again later.
errors.GUEST_AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider is temporarily unavailable.
errors.GUEST_AI_RESPONSE_INVALID: The AI response could not be validated. Try again.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_SOURCE_NOT_READY: Upload a validated image before editing metadata.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_FIELD_TOO_LONG: A metadata field is too long.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_AI_RESULT_NOT_FOUN: No AI result found for this image.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_AI_RESULT_NOT_ALLO: That AI result cannot be imported here.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_RENAMED_DOWNLOAD_F: Could not prepare the renamed download.
errors.GUEST_METADATA_EDITOR_RATE_LIMITED: Too many metadata editor requests. Try again later.
errors.GUEST_BULK_LIMIT: This bulk batch exceeds the free guest limit.
errors.GUEST_BULK_TOO_MANY_FILES: Too many files for your current bulk limit.
errors.GUEST_BULK_BATCH_TOO_LARGE: Total batch size is too large.
errors.GUEST_BULK_ACTIVE_EXISTS: Wait for the current bulk job to finish.
errors.GUEST_BULK_NOT_READY: Bulk job is not ready yet.
errors.GUEST_BULK_ZIP_FAILED: Could not build the ZIP archive.
errors.GUEST_BULK_ZIP_TOO_LARGE: ZIP archive exceeds the size limit.
errors.GUEST_BULK_FEATURE_REQUIRED: This bulk feature requires an eligible account.

bulk.title: Bulk Image Tools
bulk.subtitle: Process multiple images with Compress, Resize, or Convert — private temporary storage, no login required within free limits.
bulk.singleOnly: Single-image only: Crop, Geotag, Metadata Viewer, Metadata Editor, AI Alt Text.
bulk.limitSummary: Guest bulk: up to {files} images, {batch} total, {file} per file. Each processed file uses one daily operation.
bulk.dropHint: Drag and drop or browse multiple JPEG, PNG, or WebP files. Excess files are not uploaded.
bulk.gateTooMany: You can process up to {count} images. Selected: {selected}.
bulk.gateOps: Daily guest operations are exhausted. Sign in or wait for the rolling window.
bulk.reselectAfterLogin: For your privacy, files are not retained during sign-in. Select your files again after signing in.
bulk.expiryNotice: Files are deleted within one hour. ZIP download does not extend expiry.
bulk.aiUnavailable: Bulk AI Alt Text is not available for guests. Use the single-image AI tool or an eligible account project batch.

rotate.optionsHint: Choose an angle and optional flips. Output stays in the same format.

watermark.optionsHint: Add short text with position and opacity. Keep it readable without covering the whole image.

blur.optionsHint: Choose the area to blur as percentages. Use this to hide faces or details manually.

meme.optionsHint: Add top and/or bottom caption text. Style is classic meme lettering.

footer.retention: Files expire after one hour for guests.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: No. Free guest tools work without login. Accounts unlock history, bulk, and plans.
faq.a2: Guest uploads and outputs expire one hour after session creation. Downloads do not extend that time.
